caption: Ask an agent to use a Squad
line: Any agent can start a Squad for you. Ask it to do the work with a Squad, and point it at your plan.

caption: The agent prepares a launch
line: The agent checks the plan, then prepares a launch. It does not start anything.

caption: Squad launch ready, in your Inbox
line: The prepared launch arrives as a Squad launch ready card in your Inbox. It names the Squad, the planning mode and the files. Nothing starts until you press Launch.

caption: Review Squad launch, then Launch
line: Review Squad launch opens the composer, already filled in. Check it, then press Launch.

caption: Reports go back to the conversation
line: The Squad runs, and its details show the conversation it started from. When it needs an answer, a Squad report goes back to that conversation.

caption: Run now: skip the Inbox
line: To skip the Inbox, ask the agent to run it now. The Squad starts straight away, with no card to approve.

caption: Review by default, run now when you trust it
line: Run now suits a plan you trust. Otherwise, the Inbox card keeps you in control.
